text_block_list.text:
Right after the "Representative Exchange 
Match"—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —...Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Thanks to you, I've cleared my 
doubts!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I decline the position of Japan's 
representative.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To me, accepting how much I'm currently 
lacking is a necessary part of growth.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just now, in this race against you all, I 
gave it everything I had and ran. And so—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Even if I didn't want to admit it, it 
made me realize. That I'm not there yet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we were supposed to be at the 
same starting line. Before I knew it, a 
gap had opened between us."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So from now on, I'll think about why that 
gap exists, and what I can do to close it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to observe your challenge for 
the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe' up close, 
and study it!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll even help out with training! That 
way, I should be able to grow too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will take everything I learned this year 
and use it to break an even greater jinx 
than yours in the future!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Th-that's... why...! ...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Please stop with the sweet words.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, please keep showing me 
those dependable backs of yours.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Please teach me what the world is truly 
like.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I won't give up.

...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Race' had concluded. At Mei Satake's call, 
the project participants lined up in 
formation.

The Japanese representative team is about 
to be announced. If my name isn't called 
here—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now, I will read out the names of the 
Umamusume chosen to represent us. The 
first is...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

I exchange looks with <chrname>. This year, I can 
challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
with her once again—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwoman. ...I would like to request to 
accompany the overseas expedition."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...! I had heard that you declined even 
participating in the representative 
selection itself, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. I made a choice for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I have no health concerns. Nor do I have 
any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's for my own good. To nurture and make 
good use of this power— I figured working 
behind the scenes would be best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. Not this year.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that attire... It truly reflects your 
challenge, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because we're standing up against the 
thorny jinx that has entangled so many 
famous Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! How brave... I am truly looking 
forward to that day...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ Father, Mother! Please await my 
performance with high hopes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll deliver it with these two 
legs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The moment Satono's proud "distinguished 
Umamusume" breaks through the jinx no one 
could ever shatter!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Father, Mother. Dia has not yet 
achieved enough to bring you direct joy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ――Yet, someday.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I will stand at the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe as someone worthy of these 
clothes...!
